recrafted.gun.argento.name: Argento .45
recrafted.gun.argento.desc: Long-slide stainless .45. Threaded for the house suppressor.
recrafted.gun.passero.name: Passero .22
recrafted.gun.passero.desc: Compact .22 with an integral suppressor. Heard by almost no one.
recrafted.gun.bastone.name: Bastone 9
recrafted.gun.bastone.desc: Corvara police service pistol. Fifteen rounds, no subtlety.
recrafted.gun.vento.name: Vento .357
recrafted.gun.vento.desc: Heavy six-shot revolver. A long double-action pull and a very loud answer.
recrafted.gun.lupara.name: Lupara
recrafted.gun.lupara.desc: Sawn-off side-by-side. One barrel or both; two shells, then a reload.
recrafted.gun.halcyon.name: Halcyon PDW
recrafted.gun.halcyon.desc: Halcyon lab security issue. Thirty rounds of 4.6mm, quick and quiet-ish.
recrafted.gun.bulwark.name: Bulwark AR
recrafted.gun.bulwark.desc: Full-size 5.56 rifle. Thirty rounds, automatic, and not subtle at all.
recrafted.gun.cicala.name: Cicala
recrafted.gun.cicala.desc: Takedown sniper rifle with an integral suppressor. Travels in a briefcase.
recrafted.gun.falco.name: Falco
recrafted.gun.falco.desc: Semi-automatic .308 marksman rifle. Ten rounds, reach and authority.
recrafted.gun.reiger.name: Reiger 9
recrafted.gun.reiger.desc: Amsterdam police service pistol. Slim, fifteen rounds, a light and eager trigger.
recrafted.gun.snoek.name: Snoek SMG
recrafted.gun.snoek.desc: Compact 9mm submachine gun, suppressed for its whole length. Thirty rounds, barely a whisper.
recrafted.gun.kievit.name: Kievit
recrafted.gun.kievit.desc: Over-under pocket derringer. Two rounds of .357 at arm's length, then tip the barrels.
recrafted.gun.harpoen.name: Harpoen
recrafted.gun.harpoen.desc: Pneumatic speargun. One barbed bolt, no bang at all, and a long reload.
recrafted.ammo.spear_bolt.name: Spear Bolt
recrafted.ammo.spear_bolt.desc: Stainless spear with a barbed head, for the Harpoen.
